tei:div.tei:head: HA-MAVDIL
tei:div.tei:p:
He who marks the holy from the profane,
May he also pardon our transgressions;
May he multiply our seed as the sand,
And as the stars that appear in the night.

Let not my supplication be repelled;
Open heaven’s exalted gate for me,
Seeing that my head is drenched with the dew,
My locks are wet with the drops of the night.

Revered God, O respond to my prayer;
I call for thy help, O grant redemption,
In the twilight, the evening of the day,
And in the profound blackness of the night.

O cleanse the impurity of my deeds,
So that those who provoke me may not say:
“Where then is the God who created you,
He who inspires you to sing in the night?”
